sources.title: Flamingo (visual language model) - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: What made Flamingo's few-shot results notable? Flamingo is designed to be used the way a large language model is prompted. A user constructs a sequence that interleaves example image-and-answer pairs with a final query image, and the model completes the text.

sources.title: HuggingFaceM4/idefics-80b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Original Paper: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning IDEFICS is a large multimodal English model that takes sequences of interleaved images and texts as inputs and generates text outputs. The model shows strong in-context few-shot learning capabilities and is on par with the closed-source model.

sources.title: OpenFlamingo-4B-vitl-rpj3b - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OpenFlamingo is an open source implementation of DeepMind's Flamingo models. This 4B-parameter model uses a CLIP ViT-L/14 vision encoder and RedPajama-3B language model. Model Details We follow the Flamingo modeling paradigm, outfitting the layers of a pretrained, frozen language model such that they cross-attend to visual features when decoding.
